text:
alyssa: Heads-up — observed an oscillating failover pattern in staging this morning between region-eu and region-us for tenant group 'alpha'. Switch frequency ~30s, looks environmental rather than operator-triggered. Pasting a short extract of events and a heap of logs in case folks want to triage.

ben_thompson: Can you paste the lease/health-change timeline? Also which load balancer health-checks fired?

alyssa: Sure, quick snippet: 
```
[2026-03-23T08:12:01Z] region-eu health=ok
[2026-03-23T08:12:15Z] region-eu p99=320ms -> marked degraded
[2026-03-23T08:12:32Z] lease-swap -> route -> region-us
[2026-03-23T08:12:58Z] region-us p99=280ms -> region-us marked degraded -> swap back
```
Seems the control-plane decision loop is too eager — current cooldown is 10s in staging.

samir: We had a similar pattern on canary last week when packet-loss spiked on a single AZ. Those quick flips usually happen when p99 crosses 200–250ms and health-check windows are tiny. :thinking:

jordan: Two axes to consider: 1) tune cooldown + jitter to break the feedback loop, 2) add per-tenant dampening to avoid noisy tenants thrashing routes. For 2) something like soft-quarantine after N switches in M minutes.

alyssa: I can prototype a config approach. Example payload: 
```
{
  "failover_cooldown_ms": 60000,
  "cooldown_jitter_pct": 20,
  "oscillation_window_min": "10m",
  "max_switches_in_window": 5
}
```
This would make the decision circuit add backoff and stop swapping for tenants that exceed the threshold.

ops-bot: Canary rollout started: config/failover-cooldown/2026-03-23 -> staging (3 pods).

ben_thompson: Before we flip at scale, add telemetry: emit failover.switch_count per-tenant and failover.cooldown_applied boolean. We should also log the reason code for each swap (p99 spike vs health-probe vs manual). Then run a synthetic churn test.

samir: Also add a KV-cache probe in the chaos script. If cache misses spike, that can add tail latency causing false positives. Check kv_cache.miss_rate aligned with swap times.

jordan: One more safety: server-side lease TTL math. If we set TTL to 3x health-check interval and make renewals idempotent, we can avoid split-brain when retries overlap. Might need a tiny change in the lease refresh algorithm.

alyssa: Proposed plan: 
1) emit the extra metrics (switch_count, cooldown_applied, swap_reason).
2) bump staging cooldown to 60s + jitter and enable per-tenant dampening config.
3) run 2h chaos sim (packet loss + pod churn + cache eviction) against staging and collect metrics.
4) if stable, open RFC to adopt 60s default for Dedicated and Hosted "high-stability" tier, but keep a short cooldown for low-latency-first tenants. I'll open a tracking PR with experiment checklist.

ben_thompson: SGTM. @alyssa please add the list of telemetry queries we need and the failure-mode acceptance criteria in the PR. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll add the KV cache probe and wire kv metrics into the dashboard.

alyssa: Thanks — will follow up in the PR and tag y'all for review.
